name: layout.rowPacked
doc: A row-packed drawing for a diagram read for its order rather than its durations: every node keeps the rows its `position` covers and is drawn at `packedWidth` where it has one, and the nodes are placed left to right in the order of their `position`'s left edge (ties by id). Nodes starting at one left edge are placed as a group at the larger of where the previous group ended and where every row it covers is free again: the last node's right edge there plus `gap`, plus the node's `leading` room for a label drawn before it; with `followConnections`, also no earlier than halfway along every node already placed that an edge leads from, plus `gap` and its `leading`. A later node of a group on a row an earlier one took follows it there. The first group keeps its own left edge. A node covers every row line from `floor(top / rowStep)` to `floor((bottom - 1) / rowStep)`, or the row of its own top without `rowStep`. Positions are the nodes' top-left corners and keep each node's `y`; `sizes` gives the width of each node of `types` (every node without `types`).

gap.doc: The least clear space between two nodes on one row.

rowStep.doc: The distance between two row lines; absent, a node's row is its own top.

followConnections.doc: Whether a node an edge leads into starts no earlier than halfway along its source.

types.doc: The node types drawn at their packed width; absent, every node is. A node of another type keeps its own width and is still placed in order and clear of its neighbours.

width.doc: One width every node of `types` is drawn at; absent, each takes its `packedWidth`, or keeps its own width without one.

packedWidth.doc: The width a node is drawn at, where it is bound per node.

leading.doc: The room a node needs clear before its left edge, for a label drawn there; absent, none.
